title.description: Intelligent spatial decision support for big onion farmers. Predict your yield, understand the reasons, and get expert recommendations.

form.knownSectionHelp: We automatically collect weather, satellite, soil and historical harvest information for your area. These values are filled in for you and cannot be edited.
form.contextUnavailable: No records found for this area yet. The prediction will use wider district and seasonal averages.

dashboard.fill_form: Fill out the form and click Predict Yield to see the AI analysis.
dashboard.make_prediction: Please make a prediction first to see personalized agricultural advice.
dashboard.mapHint: Click any highlighted district on the map to view yield insights.

predict.title: Predict Onion Yield
predict.subtitle: Choose your district and season. We fill in the weather, satellite and soil data for you.
predict.waitingDescription: Choose your field details and tap Predict Yield to get the AI analysis
predict.intervalConformal: {pct}% conformal prediction interval, calibrated on leave-one-year-out residuals. The true yield falls in this range {pct} times out of 100.
predict.intervalGaussian: Range estimated as ±1.96 × the model's error (RMSE). Approximate, not calibrated.
predict.intervalHeuristic: Rough ±15% estimate only — this model has no calibrated interval yet.

reliabilityNote.high: This model explains most of the variation in past harvests. Treat the range as a solid guide.
reliabilityNote.medium: This model explains some of the variation in past harvests. Use the range alongside your own judgement.
reliabilityNote.low: This model explains very little of the variation in past harvests — it is close to predicting the district average. Treat the range as a rough guide only, not a forecast.
reliabilityNote.unknown: Model accuracy has not been recorded. Treat this as an indication only.

predict.successDescription: AI has successfully generated yield prediction
predict.error: Prediction failed — backend unavailable. Please try again later.
predict.districtsError: Could not load districts — backend unavailable.

chat.title: Ask about this prediction
chat.subtitle: Ask in plain language — answers are grounded in the prediction and history for your selected district, season and year.
chat.placeholder: e.g. Why is this yield lower than last year?
chat.emptyState: Ask a question about the current prediction, e.g. "How confident are you?" or "Why is this the estimate?"
chat.needsPrediction: Run a prediction first so the assistant has something to explain.
chat.error: The assistant is unavailable right now. Please try again later.
chat.notConfigured: The assistant isn't configured on the server yet.

recommend.title: Recommended Actions
recommend.subtitle: Based on your predicted yield and crop conditions
recommend.noDescription: Please make a prediction first to see personalized agricultural advice.
recommend.ifYouActText: Improving these conditions may help reduce yield loss in future cultivation.
recommend.allGoodDesc: Your predicted conditions are within the recommended range for big onion cultivation. Keep up your current practices.
recommend.expertDesc: Contact your local agriculture officer for field-specific guidance.

soil_ph_low.title: Soil condition
soil_ph_low.reason: Soil pH ({current}) is below the recommended range for big onion growth ({min}–{max}).
soil_ph_low.action: Improve soil condition before the next cultivation stage — apply agricultural lime to raise soil pH.

soil_ph_high.title: Soil condition
soil_ph_high.reason: Soil pH ({current}) is above the recommended range for big onion growth ({min}–{max}).
soil_ph_high.action: Apply sulfur or organic matter to gradually lower soil pH before the next cultivation stage.

water_deficit.title: Water management
water_deficit.reason: Rainfall this season ({current} mm) was below what big onion typically needs ({min}+ mm), which may have affected crop growth.
water_deficit.action: Maintain proper irrigation during dry periods, especially during bulb development.

heat_stress.title: Heat stress risk
heat_stress.reason: High temperature conditions ({current} heat-stress days this season) reduced your expected yield.
heat_stress.action: Monitor soil moisture and maintain irrigation during hot spells.

humidity_disease_risk.title: Disease-prone conditions
humidity_disease_risk.reason: High humidity ({current}%) during the season increases the risk of fungal disease such as purple blotch.
humidity_disease_risk.action: Ensure good field drainage and airflow, and watch crops for early signs of disease.

explain.title: Why this prediction?
explain.noDescription: Please make a prediction first to see explanation.
explain.insightPositive: {feature} was the strongest influence and it helped your yield. Keeping those conditions steady is the surest way to hold this level.
explain.insightNegative: {feature} was the strongest influence and it held your yield back. See the Recommendations page for what to do about it.
explain.perFactorPositive: {feature} increased your predicted yield by about {amount} kg/Ha.
explain.perFactorNegative: {feature} decreased your predicted yield by about {amount} kg/Ha.

summaryNote.levelHigh: This explanation is well grounded — you can trust these factors.
summaryNote.levelMedium: This explanation is reasonably grounded — treat it as a helpful guide alongside your own judgement.
summaryNote.levelLow: This explanation has limited grounding — treat these factors as a rough guide only.
summaryNote.unknown: We don't have a reliability score for this explanation yet.
